summary: Master the art of managing tenders, specifications, and contracts with our expert-led course. Equip yourself with skills for successful project delivery.
lede: Tender preparation training helps teams turn procurement requirements into clear documents and manage bids through evaluation and award. It is for procurement officers, tender managers, and contract administrators who prepare specifications, coordinate bid evaluations, or oversee contracts. Learners practise setting measurable acceptance criteria, packaging tenders, scoring offers, recording clarifications, and assessing variations using evaluation matrices and contract registers.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who prepare procurement documents, evaluate supplier offers, manage awards, or control performance after contract signature. It works for foundation to intermediate learners who need a structured tender management approach without assuming specialist legal or engineering qualifications.
prerequisites: No formal procurement qualification is required. You should have basic exposure to purchasing, project delivery, supplier management, contract administration, or business requirements. Familiarity with spreadsheets is helpful, but no coding or programming is required. Advanced contract law, quantity surveying, and engineering concepts are introduced at operational application level rather than technical implementation level.
